title: S9 collage-overlap — two or three overlapping images at different scales
idea: Two or three images at different scales, overlapping, with one caption. Depth and scale difference carry the band rather than a grid.
why_new: every multi-image band today is a grid whose items never touch. offset-grid staggers the tops but keeps the items apart, so overlap is inexpressible.
built_from: one group with absolutely placed image children, or negative margins on a column row, plus a CSS hook and a stacking order.
risk: the highest of the ten. Free placement produces a different composition on every build unless the offsets are code-owned and fixed to two or three reviewed arrangements. Overlap destroys crop, so it needs the same photography gate as offset-grid, and it must resolve to a plain stack on mobile.
